title: Native cochain restriction tensor comparison
statement: For any native open tensor datum, termwise restriction commutes naturally with the actual unbounded native sum-total tensor on two complexes.

source.place: lemma-pullback-tensor-product; lemma-j-shriek-and-tensor; totalization of the sheaf comparisons

proof.text: Totalize the natural sheaf restriction comparison. The relevant open functor is a left adjoint, hence preserves countable diagonal coproducts. The generic total comparison API proves the inverse identities, differential compatibility, and naturality. For projection totalize the inverse and then invert the resulting comparison.
